title: $? lists only what is out of date
objective: Make one of two prerequisites newer than the target and watch $? shrink while $^ stays the same.
hint: $^ and $< never change; $? reports only the prerequisites whose timestamp is newer than the target's, which is the list you would hand to a compiler.

steps.description: with no target file every prerequisite counts
steps.stdout:
touch one
touch two
newer: one two
all: one two
first: one
touch hey

steps.description: make one of the two prerequisites newer
$? now names just the newer prerequisite
steps.stdout:
newer: one
all: one two
first: one
touch hey
